description: Create, update ,delete and replace Eventgrid Topic Subscriptions.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: advanced_filter
parameters.description: An advanced filter enables filtering of events based on a specific event property. KEY[.INNERKEY] FILTEROPERATOR VALUE [VALUE …] Examples data.Color StringIn Blue Red Orange Yellow data.Color StringNotIn Blue Red Orange Yellow subject StringContains Blue Red subject StringNotContains Blue Red subject StringBeginsWith Blue Red subject StringNotBeginsWith Blue Red subject StringEndsWith img png jpg subject StringNotEndsWith img png jpg data.property1 NumberIn 5 10 20 data.property1 NumberInRange 5,10 20,30 40,50 data.property2 NumberNotIn 100 200 300 data.property2 NumberNotInRange 100,110 200,210 300,310 data.property3 NumberLessThan 100 data.property2 NumberLessThanOrEquals 100 data.property3 NumberGreaterThan 100 data.property2 NumberGreaterThanOrEquals 100 data.property3 BoolEquals true data.property3 IsNullOrUndefined data.property3 IsNotNull

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: azure_active_directory_application_id_or_uri
parameters.description: The Azure Active Directory Application Id or Uri to get the access token that will be included as the bearer token in delivery requests. Applicable only for webhook as a destination.

parameters.name: azure_active_directory_tenant_id
parameters.description: The Azure Active Directory Tenant Id to get the access token that will be included as the bearer token in delivery requests. Applicable only for webhook as a destination.

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: deadletter_endpoint
parameters.description: The Azure resource ID of an Azure Storage blob container destination where EventGrid should deadletter undeliverable events for this event subscription.

parameters.name: delivery_attribute_mapping
parameters.description: Add delivery attribute mapping to send additional information via HTTP headers when delivering events. This attribute is valid for all destination types except StorageQueue. Format attribute-name attribute-type attribute-value [attribute-is-secret] somename dynamic somevalue true somename2 static somevalue

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: enable_advanced_filtering_on_arrays
parameters.description: Allows advanced filters to be evaluated against an array of values instead of expecting a singular value. Choices: false true

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Endpoint where EventGrid should deliver events matching this event subscription. For webhook endpoint type, this should be the corresponding webhook URL. For other endpoint types, this should be the Azure resource identifier of the endpoint. It is expected that the destination endpoint to be already created and available for use before executing any Event Grid command.

parameters.name: endpoint_type
parameters.description: The type of the destination endpoint. Choices: "azurefunction" "eventhub" "hybridconnection" "servicebusqueue" "servicebustopic" "storagequeue" "webhook" ← (default)

parameters.name: event_delivery_schema
parameters.description: The schema in which events should be delivered for this event subscription. By default, events will be delivered in the same schema in which they are published (based on the corresponding topic’s input schema). Choices: "CloudEventSchemaV1_0" "CustomInputSchema" "EventGridSchema"

parameters.name: event_ttl
parameters.description: Event time to live (in minutes). Must be a number between 1 and 1440. Default: 1440

parameters.name: expiration_date
parameters.description: Date or datetime (in UTC, e.g. ‘2018-11-30T11:59:59+00:00’ or ‘2018-11-30’) after which the event subscription would expire. By default, there is no expiration for the event subscription.

parameters.name: included_event_types
parameters.description: A list of event types (e.g., Microsoft.Storage.BlobCreated and Microsoft.Storage.BlobDeleted). In order to subscribe to all default event types, do not specify any value for this argument. For event grid topics, event types are customer defined. For Azure events, e.g., Storage Accounts, IoT Hub, etc., you can query their event types using this CLI command ‘az eventgrid topic-type list-event-types’.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: A list of labels to associate with this event subscription.

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: max_delivery_attempts
parameters.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts. Must be a number between 1 and 30. Default: 30

parameters.name: max_events_per_batch
parameters.description: Maximum number of events in a batch. Must be a number between 1 and 5000.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the subscription.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: preferred_batch_size_in_kilobytes
parameters.description: Preferred batch size in kilobytes. Must be a number between 1 and 1024.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of a resource group where the topic exists or will be created.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the Eventgrid Topic Event Subscription. Use present to create or update and absent to delete. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: storage_queue_msg_ttl
parameters.description: Storage queue message time to live in seconds.

parameters.name: subject_begins_with
parameters.description: An optional string to filter events for an event subscription based on a prefix. Wildcard characters are not supported.

parameters.name: subject_case_sensitive
parameters.description: Specify to indicate whether the subject fields should be compared in a case sensitive manner. True if flag present. Choices: false true

parameters.name: subject_ends_with
parameters.description: An optional string to filter events for an event subscription based on a suffix. Wildcard characters are not supported.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: topic_name
parameters.description: Name of the topic.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Subscribe to custom topic
  azure.azcollection.azure_rm_eventgrid_subscription:
    name: subscription-xxxxx20070
    topic_name: topic-xxxxx20070
    endpoint: https://event-grid-site-xxxxx20070.azurewebsites.net/api/updates

return_values.name: changed
return_values.description: Whether the resource is changed. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: eventgrid_subscriptions
return_values.description: List of Eventgrid subscriptions. Returned: always

return_values.name: destination
return_values.description: Details of the destination Returned: always

return_values.name: endpoint_base_url
return_values.description: The base URL of the endpoint Returned: always Sample: "https://event-grid-site-xxxxx20070.azurewebsites.net/api/updates"

return_values.name: endpoint_type
return_values.description: The type of the endpoint Returned: always Sample: "WebHook"

return_values.name: max_events_per_batch
return_values.description: How many events will be batched Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: preferred_batch_size_in_kilobytes
return_values.description: The preferred batch size in kilobytes Returned: always Sample: 64

return_values.name: event_delivery_schema
return_values.description: The type of Eventgrid Schema Returned: always Sample: "EventGridSchema"

return_values.name: filter
return_values.description: Filter settings for which events to publish to endpoint Returned: always

return_values.name: subject_begins_with
return_values.description: Filter on Subject beginning with this value Returned: always

return_values.name: subject_ends_with
return_values.description: Filter on Subject ending with this value Returned: always

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: The ID of the Eventgrid Subscription Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/MyResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.EventGrid/topics/topic-xxxxx20070/providers/Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions/subscription-xxxxx20070"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the Eventgrid Subscription Returned: always Sample: "subscription-xxxxx20070"

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: The provisioning state of this Eventgrid Subscription Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: retry_policy
return_values.description: Retry policy for this Eventgrid Subscription Returned: always

return_values.name: event_time_to_live_in_minutes
return_values.description: Event time to live in minutes Returned: always Sample: 1440

return_values.name: max_delivery_attempts
return_values.description: Max attempts to deliver to endpoint Returned: always Sample: 30

return_values.name: topic
return_values.description: The source resource id that the Eventgrid Subscription is subscribed to Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/MyResourceGroup/providers/microsoft.eventgrid/topics/topic-xxxxx20070"

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The type of Eventgrid Subscription Returned: always Sample: "Microsoft.EventGrid/eventSubscriptions"
